column1: # SignetGroup storage layout — the layout that is DEPLOYED.
# This is the baseline `alpha-contracts.sh check-layout` compares a candidate
# implementation against before it will let one be deployed for a beacon
# upgrade. It is not documentation of the current source; it is a record of what
# the live proxies' storage already means. Those two are the same thing only
# between upgrades, which is exactly when the check has nothing to say.
# Why a beacon upgrade needs this at all: BeaconProxy keeps its state in the
# proxy and takes only code from the implementation, so a new implementation
# that assigns different meanings to the same slots does not migrate anything —
# it reinterprets live data in place. Every existing group, including ones this
# repo does not manage, silently changes meaning in the same transaction.
# The rule the check enforces:
#   1. Every non-gap entry here must appear in the candidate at the same slot,
#      the same offset, and with the same type. No reordering, no widening, no
#      removal, no repurposing.
#   2. New state may only occupy slots taken from the head of __gap.
#   3. The total footprint (__gap slot + __gap length) must be unchanged, so
#      the contract occupies the same slot range before and after.
# Types are normalized before comparison: solc suffixes struct and enum type
# ids with an AST node id that moves whenever an unrelated line is added above,
# so comparing them raw reports drift that does not exist. Array lengths are
# NOT stripped — `t_array(t_uint256)46_storage` differing from `...42_storage`
# is the gap shrinking, which is the thing being measured.
# Provenance — this was not transcribed from the source, it was read back from
# the chain:
#   Recorded  : 2026-08-31 (after the SIWE-domain beacon upgrade)
#   Source    : 862b2cf ("feat(siwe): move domain binding on-chain, per-group")
#   Impl      : 0x790c546357ca7f588c68DC8A2C42baB5025276c4 (Ethereum mainnet)
#   Beacon    : 0xE37C3768C12fF0ECFb78e63ED26De98c08a7d716
#   Verified  : the deployed runtime bytecode at that address is a byte-for-byte
#               match for a local build of this tree, metadata included
#               (sha256 d93ddcc1…, 29,974 chars), and its init-code hash matches
#               the 0x542a1c4d… reported at deploy — so this layout is the one
#               live groups actually use, not an assumption about which commit
#               was deployed.
#   Upgrade    : beacon moved 0x44B09BCD -> 0x790c5463, signed by the factory
#               read zero on the live group both before and after, so the four
#               new fields landed on virgin storage rather than reinterpreting
#               anything.
#   Previous  : 0x44B09BCD4Ec1B5faF9E8D35b607B0dDc39020D98, source cddc5a2,
#               __gap[46] at slot 20.
# UPDATE THIS FILE WHEN AN UPGRADE LANDS, not when the source changes. Regenerate
# with:
#   testnet/scripts/alpha-contracts.sh check-layout --write-baseline
# and record the new implementation address above.
# slot
